fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Roobert', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Royal Plum
palette.role: Primary brand color — hero washes, product frames, active nav indicator, link accents, and decorative section bands. Carries 100% of the chromatic brand weight; the system is monochrome until this color appears

palette.name: Plum Mist
palette.role: Tinted lilac surface used for soft product/section backgrounds and as the lightest stop in purple gradient washes. Pairs with Royal Plum to create a two-stop purple atmosphere without needing darker midtones

palette.name: Lilac Outline
palette.role: Decorative stroke accent — used sparingly on illustration outlines, diagram borders, and ornamental SVG marks that sit over plum surfaces

palette.name: Forest Mark
palette.role: Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Primary text and heading color. Slightly warm-tinted near-black that reads softer than pure #000 on cream backgrounds; the canonical ink for all reading content

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Primary action button background (dark filled CTA) and deep border color. The non-chromatic counterpart to Royal Plum — same near-black temperature, used wherever a button needs to feel grounded and serious

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Secondary text, input borders, form labels, and muted UI chrome. The mid-neutral that carries the majority of metadata and helper copy

palette.name: Warm Gray
palette.role: Muted body text, tag labels, and tertiary borders. Reads as a soft taupe on cream — used for de-emphasized prose and quiet UI labels

palette.name: Mist Gray
palette.role: Disabled text, placeholder copy, and the lightest readable neutral. Used where content must recede but remain legible

palette.name: Hairline
palette.role: Default border color for cards, dividers, input fields, and table rows. The single hairline that draws almost every structural line on the site

palette.name: Parchment
palette.role: Page background canvas — a warm near-white with a barely-perceptible violet cast that ties the neutral surface to the Royal Plum accent without competing with it

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Card and elevated surface background. Sits one step brighter than Parchment to create a subtle two-tier surface stack without using shadows

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Pure black reserved for SVG strokes, icon fills, and the deepest image borders. Not used for text or buttons — those live in the warmer Obsidian/Graphite family
